module: Performance certification ("performance index") of career vehicles, from the garage computer. startDragTest chains, with util_stepHandler, a recorded drag test on the alderStrip track (west_coast_usa) (power, 0-60 time, 60 ft, 330 ft, 1/8, 1000 ft, 1/4 mile, speeds, braking), then an AI-driven 10-lap skidpad test (lateral acceleration). The data is stored in vehicle.certificationData, the history (10 entries max) in performanceHistory, then converted to scores and class by gameplay_vehiclePerformance. Also handles the test cameras, action blocking during the test and cancellation (user, stuck vehicle, broken engine).
notes: During the test, the other inventory vehicles are deactivated and traffic dispersed; the vehicle is filled with fuel; a group of blocked actions certificationBlockedActions is activated (radial menu, big map, walking, physics reset, nodegrabber, triggers, gearbox mode).
The test is cancelled if the vehicle moves less than 0.1 m for 7 s (considered stuck) or if the engine suffers catastrophic overtorque / locks up (cancellation after 3 s).
cancelTest(delay, userAborted): delay = seconds to wait (real time) before going to the last step; userAborted ~= false and a test in progress emits the onGameplayActivityAborted hook.
invalidateCertification moves the old certification into the history and deletes it; the tuning purchase calls it.
The 0-60 mph time is computed by observing the speed (26.8224 m/s) during the run, subtracting the reaction time.
addScoresToPerformanceData unlocks the PERFOMANCE_INDEX achievements (spelling from the code) and, for class X, HIGH_END_PERFORMANCE; the full test unlocks PERFORMANCE_INDEXED.
The onVehicleDamaged hook is called by a Lua injection callback on the vehicle side (damageTracker.registerDamageUpdateCallback) that serializes the data.
In getAggregateScoresFromVehId and getVehicleClass, the return is nil if the vehicle has no certificationData.

startDragTest.desc: Starts the full certification test on the active vehicle (activeInventoryId): fade to black, vehicle spawn, recorded drag test, then skidpad (10 laps), saving of the results, return to the garage and return to the performance screen. If autosave is active, saves the career at the end.

invalidateCertification.desc: Archives a vehicle's current certification into its history then deletes it (called after a parts or tuning change).

isTestInProgress.desc: Indicates whether a certification test is in progress.

returns.desc: true during the test, nil otherwise.

cancelTest.desc: Requests cancellation of the current test and stops the camera zoom and the skidpad test.

delay.desc: Delay in seconds before the actual stop, 0 by default.

userAborted.desc: false if the cancellation is automatic (no onGameplayActivityAborted hook).

getAggregateScoresFromVehId.desc: Returns the aggregate scores (gameplay_vehiclePerformance.getAggregateScores) from a vehicle's certification.

translatePerformanceDataForUi.desc: Translates in place the drivetrain, fuelType, inductionType fields of a performance data block for display.

addScoresToPerformanceData.desc: Adds the performanceAggregateScores and vehicleClass fields to a data block and unlocks the associated achievements.

openMenu.desc: Sets the active vehicle and navigates to the career.computer.vehiclePerformance screen.

getActiveVehicleUiData.desc: UI data of the active vehicle (career_modules_inventory.getVehicleUiData).

returns.desc: UI data, nil if no active vehicle.

onRouteMount.desc: UI router hook: attaches the active vehicle's data to data.vehicleData when the route is mounted.

onUpdate.desc: Update hook: updates the braking camera zoom.

onBeamNGTrigger.desc: Triggers hook: changes the camera path (drag_pi_2 to 5) on entering the dragStageTrigger, drag60ftTrigger, dragTestTrigger2/3 triggers, and switches to the external camera on exiting dragEndCamTrigger. Only handles the test vehicle.

onDragCountdownStarted.desc: Drag hook: 1 s after the countdown starts, switches to the start camera (behind the vehicle).

onComputerAddFunctions.desc: Garage computer hook: adds the "performance index" button for each garage vehicle (disabled until the starter vehicle is bought).

onVehicleDamaged.desc: Called from the vehicle via a damageTracker callback: cancels the test after 3 s in case of catastrophic overtorque or a locked engine.
